source_provenance.note: The observed local repository had no commits. No source commit is invented or inferred for 0005.

known_defects: algorithm label ES256 does not enforce EC P-256 key type/curve; P-384 and RSA verification were accepted in hostile probes
recipient acknowledgement can regress from processed to delivered
same message ID with different immutable content is treated as a duplicate rather than an idempotency conflict
audit corruption turns health red but does not block queue mutations
corrupt queue JSON can poison fetch while overall health remains ok
current implementation does not quarantine corrupt queue records
current audit has no new bounded rotation
request rate limiting present in predecessor work was not restored
several queue/core validation errors fall through to HTTP 500
npm validate references a stale non-0005 artifact path
postupgrade writes a stale 0.3.0-0001 upgrade marker
design/plan text contains stale Ed25519 references while implementation uses P-256
deployment preflight evidence in dist is stale and refers to 0001
relay stores a field named ciphertext but does not itself establish end-to-end encryption
source tree lacks immutable Git commit provenance

disposition.meaning: 0005 is preserved as prototype/runtime evidence. Security and protocol fixes belong to the 0.4.0 successor cut.
